ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) linear and punctate disruptions. Estimated macro-level ratio is 85:15 low-to-high intensity.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous dark pigmentation across the base of both lobes; dense distribution of high-contrast white linear filaments across the mid-sections; high-intensity white circular clusters concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; estimated pixel angle of 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with low-to-mid amplitude variations; distinct jagged indentations visible on the medial portion of the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch to the outer tips, forming a characteristic 'W' shape across the horizontal axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located on the leading and trailing edges of the extreme distal tips, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Highly dense network of intersecting white linear marks (rake marks) distributed across the entire visible ventral surface; varied orientation including horizontal and diagonal trajectories.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the ventral surface; significant white scarring and possible tissue irregularity at the lobe tips due to parasitic/crustacean attachment.
